title: Agent Bridge Local Heartbeat
description: Outbound signal from a local machine advertising optional amplification capacity (LM Studio + tri-LLM). Cloud remains source of truth. Heartbeat never authorises payments, fulfilment, or multiplayer claims.

architecture.local: optional accelerator when machine is on and models are loaded

auth.notes: Shared secret stored only in local env and cloud secrets. Never in git or browser.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the signal

lm_studio.description: True if LM Studio is reachable on the local machine

tri_llm.description: True if the configured tri-LLM stack is loaded and ready

models.description: Optional list of loaded model identifiers

200.description: Heartbeat accepted and recorded with short TTL

proves: A machine possessing the shared token was able to reach the endpoint at the stated time
The sender reported LM Studio and tri-LLM status
does_not_prove: That the local machine is still online after the TTL expires

rate_guidance: Recommended interval 30–60 seconds while local stack is active. Cloud may enforce a minimum interval.
security: Token must be high-entropy and rotated if exposed
Endpoint must reject requests without valid Bearer token
No secrets, personal data, or raw model prompts in the payload
Heartbeat records are operational, not commercial evidence
